name: SM_Scythe_PR

textures.channels: tangent normal, OpenGL (green up; flip green on import)
R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic

material_exception: unique BC/N/ORM bake private to this asset (not a row of ART_STANDARD.md section 2): the task for the unclaimed families asks for a baked set per asset, and the surface detail here (see dresses) does not exist in the shared library
pivot: base centre (bbox centre in X/Y, mesh bottom at z = 0), front on -Y
dresses: scythe, 1.6 m snath with two grips, iron ring and a 75 cm curved blade
status: source delivered; not imported into Unreal, not bound in families.json
known_weaknesses: The blade is a flat tapered sweep: no rib along its back, no tang, and the edge is not ground to a bevel. The original frame is closer to a long-handled hook; a scythe was built. Parts are separate swept solids pushed together (no modelled sockets, rivets, wedges or pegs). Wood grain is procedural streaking along the object axis. Authored lying flat; the original frames show it leaning against a wall, which is a placement rotation.
